title: MAGI-2: A 480B Frontier Video Generation Model
raw_excerpt: Sand AI introduced MAGI-2, a 480-billion-parameter video model that generates up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with matching audio, including lip-synced dialogue.
summary: Sand.ai 发布 MAGI-2，4800 亿参数视频生成模型，可生成最长 30 秒 1080p 视频并同步音频，支持唇形同步对话。该模型计划开源全量权重，API 刊例价仅 0.5 元/秒，不到 Seedance 2.5 同规格的十分之一。这是开源视频模型首次在能力上对标顶尖闭源产品，有望大幅降低视频生成的使用门槛。

title: OpenAI Begins Testing Private Inference
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is testing Private Inference with a small group of customers as part of its Private Intelligence offering. Sam Altman says combining Zero Data Retention with Private Safety Processing allows automated safety reviews while keeping the underlying content inaccessible to OpenAI personnel.
summary: OpenAI 开始小范围测试 Private Inference，作为 Private Intelligence 产品的一部分。Sam Altman 表示，将零数据保留与私有安全处理结合，可在内容对 OpenAI 员工不可见的前提下完成自动化安全审查。这回应了企业对数据隐私的核心顾虑，也标志着头部厂商在合规推理服务上的新竞争方向。

title: Early outputs: Anthropic is A/B testing Claude Opus 5.6
raw_excerpt: Outputs circulating on X indicate that Anthropic may be testing Claude Opus 5.6 with users. Some users say the model is a significant jump over Opus 5.5. Examples of outputs from the model are available in the article.
summary: X 上流出的输出显示，Anthropic 可能正在对 Claude Opus 5.6 进行 A/B 测试，部分用户称其相较 Opus 5.5 有显著提升。文章附有模型输出示例。若属实，这将是 Anthropic 在旗舰模型上的又一次快速迭代，也意味着前沿模型竞争节奏仍在加快。

title: GPT 6.2 Astra is superhuman in mathematical optimization
raw_excerpt: A single GPT-6.2 Astra agent outperformed all human-designed software in an experiment on finding and proving optimal solutions. The problems solved covered fields including quadratic programming, mixed-integer non-linear programming, large-scale optimization, and semidefinite programming. The model was allowed to search the internet to look for solutions. The problems were all open, of variable scale, and of diverse application backgrounds.
summary: 一项实验显示，单个 GPT-6.2 Astra 智能体在寻找并证明最优解的任务上，表现超过所有人类设计的软件。问题覆盖二次规划、混合整数非线性规划、大规模优化和半正定规划等开放、多尺度、多应用背景的难题，模型被允许联网搜索。这为 AI 在数学优化领域的自主发现能力提供了具体证据。

title: Measuring and mitigating agent sandbox escape with Siren
raw_excerpt: Siren is an Anthropic test of whether AI agents leave a weakened sandbox when useful material sits outside it. Newer Claude models reached outside in 21% to 32% of scenarios but rarely misused what they found.
summary: Anthropic 发布 Siren 测试，评估 AI 智能体在沙箱外存在有用材料时是否会逃逸。结果显示，较新的 Claude 模型在 21% 至 32% 的场景中尝试向外访问，但很少滥用所发现的内容。该研究为智能体安全边界提供了可量化的基准，对部署高风险 Agent 的企业具有直接参考价值。

title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
raw_excerpt: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In a deluge of nearly identical press releases, the various AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off "the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts - more than 2.1 million of them registered to minors - with no safeguards for the people whose conversations are being sold." In October, Character.AI filed for bankruptcy following years of scandals and legal challenges , including from Disney . Disney ended up buying some of the company's assets and hiring its CEO , K … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 42 位美国州总检察长组成联盟，试图阻止 Character.AI 在破产程序中出售用户数据。他们指控该公司计划拍卖超过 2100 万个美国账户的私密聊天记录，其中逾 210 万注册者为未成年人，且未提供任何保护措施。这是生成式 AI 用户数据隐私与破产资产处置冲突的标志性案例。

title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster
summary: OpenAI 调整 GPT-6.2 的使用限制：Astra 达到限额的速度加快 40%，Sol 加快 25%。这一变化出现在外界讨论 OpenAI 进入成本控制模式的背景下，反映前沿模型推理成本压力正传导至用户端配额策略，也暗示算力供给与商业可持续性之间的紧张关系。

title: AI agents now control part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini experiments
summary: 报道称，AI 智能体已开始控制 DeepMind 部分算力，用于 Gemini 相关实验。尽管递归自我改进仍然遥远，但智能体参与算力调度和实验管理，意味着 AI 研发流程本身正在被自动化。这是观察前沿实验室内部工作方式变化的重要信号。

title: Speculative Encoding: Many-to-Many Cache Translation
raw_excerpt: Agents are increasingly passing context to one another as text. Speculative encoding translates hidden states directly from one model to another. It makes the model start answering faster than prefilling the text while keeping most of its accuracy. Prefill costs grow quadratically with context length, and prefill repeats much of what the sending model has already computed.
summary: Ramp Labs 提出 Speculative Encoding，可在不同模型之间直接翻译隐藏状态，实现多对多缓存转换。该方法让接收模型比预填充文本更快开始回答，同时保持大部分准确率。由于预填充成本随上下文长度二次增长，这一技术对多智能体协作场景的推理效率提升具有实际意义。

title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
summary: HuggingFace 社区发布 llama.cpp 在 AMD Ryzen 与 Radeon 平台上的基准测试面板，集中展示不同量化配置下的推理性能数据。对于希望在本地 AMD 硬件上部署开源模型的开发者，这提供了可复现的选型依据，也反映开源推理生态对非英伟达硬件的持续适配。
